h1: The 4 Best Video Doorbells Without Smartphones of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four video doorbells and intercoms that work with an indoor monitor instead of a phone app, compared on setup, power and price.
summary: The TKMARS No WiFi/App Needed model is our top pick because its title states outright that no app or WiFi is required. The two TKMARS monitor kits come next for a screen inside the house, and the AMOCAM wired intercom suits apartments.
intro: Plenty of video doorbells are marketed as no subscription yet still demand a phone app to see anything. If you do not own a smartphone, or simply do not want one tied to your front door, that distinction is the whole purchase.

We reviewed eight listings and kept four that actually offer a non-phone way to see the door: an indoor monitor, an explicit no-app claim or a wired intercom. Doorbells that only say no subscription were dropped, since that does not prove they work without a phone.

products.name: TKMARS Wireless Doorbell Camera No Subscription No WiFi/App Needed
products.verdict: The listing says outright that no WiFi or app is needed.
products.description:
This TKMARS is a wireless 1080P doorbell camera that is sold with no subscription and with no WiFi or app needed, according to its title.

Its title is the only one that spells out the no-app claim, which puts it on top. It sits in the $50-100 bracket, the same as the other TKMARS models.

Best for anyone avoiding phones entirely. Confirm on the listing what unit you watch the video on, since our data does not say.
products.skipIf: You want remote viewing away from home.

products.name: TKMARS Wireless Doorbell Camera with Monitor No Subscription No
products.verdict: A battery 1080P doorbell paired with an indoor monitor.
products.description:
This TKMARS is a battery-powered, wireless 1080P doorbell camera that comes with a monitor and no subscription.

It ranks second because the monitor replaces a phone, but its title is cut off and does not explicitly say no app. It costs in the $50-100 bracket, matching the first pick.

Best for homeowners who want a screen indoors. Check the full listing for monitor size and range.
products.idealFor: Homes that want an indoor screen.

products.name: TKMARS Doorbell Camera Wireless No Subscription with Monitor for
products.verdict: Another battery, monitor-equipped TKMARS at the same price tier.
products.description:
This TKMARS is a battery-powered wireless 1080P doorbell camera with a monitor and no subscription.

It ranks third because it is nearly identical to the second pick on paper, and the title gives no extra distinguishing feature. Both are in the $50-100 bracket.

Best for buyers who want the monitor option and find this listing available. Compare it with the pick above before buying.
products.idealFor: Monitor buyers wanting a second option.
products.skipIf: You want a clearer spec list.

products.name: AMOCAM Apartment Video Intercom System
products.verdict: A wired video intercom made for apartments.
products.description:
The AMOCAM is a wired video intercom system aimed at apartments, in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks last because it costs far more than the TKMARS kits and needs wiring. It is a traditional intercom rather than a phone-linked doorbell.

Best for apartments or buildings with existing wiring. Check the listing for the full kit contents, since our data is limited.

whatMatters.detail: Many doorbells that skip a subscription still need a phone to view video. A truly phone-free model shows the picture on its own screen. Look for words like monitor, intercom or no app in the title.
A monitor is the screen that shows the visitor. Its size and range decide how useful it is. Check the listing for both, since they are not in our data.
Battery models install without wiring but need recharging. Wired intercoms never run out but need cable runs. Match to your door and building.
No subscription means no monthly fee to keep features. Confirm that local viewing works without any paid plan.
1080P is full HD and gives clear faces at the door. Look for the figure in the title.

faq.q: Can I use a doorbell camera without a smartphone?
faq.a: Only models with their own screen or intercom. The TKMARS monitor kits and the AMOCAM intercom fit this.
Assuming no subscription means no app. Many such doorbells still need a phone.

faq.q: Is the AMOCAM worth it over a TKMARS?
faq.a: Only for apartments and wired setups. The TKMARS costs far less.

faq.q: How do I install the battery models?
faq.a: Mount the doorbell and pair the included monitor following the manual. Our data does not give steps.
Recharge or replace the battery as instructed and wipe the lens periodically.

faq.q: Can I check the door while away?
faq.a: Phone-free models are designed for in-home viewing, so remote viewing is not their purpose.

finalTake: The TKMARS No WiFi/App Needed is the clearest phone-free pick. The two TKMARS monitor kits are good alternatives for an indoor screen, and the AMOCAM is the choice for apartments. Read the full listing before buying, since several titles are truncated.
